tasks.title: Graph builder: OO↔react census → hierarchical graph.json + PORT-GRAPH.md spec
tasks.accept: /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/build.py && /usr/bin/python3 -c "import json; g=json.load(open('census/port-graph/graph.json')); assert len(g['surfaces'])>=4, 'surfaces'; tabs=[t for s in g['surfaces'] if s.get('tabs') for t in s['tabs']]; assert len(tabs)>=11, 'tabs: %d'%len(tabs); sts=[c['status'] for t in tabs for c in t['controls']]; assert sts and all(x in ('done','diverged','missing') for x in sts), 'statuses'; led=[s for s in g['surfaces'] if s['id']=='ledger']; assert led and len(led[0]['clusters'])>=12, 'clusters'; print('GATE OK', len(sts), 'controls')"
tasks.note:
GOAL: a committed, coarse→detail port-state graph. Everything pure-stdlib /usr/bin/python3 — NO node, NO playwright, NO network, NO server-repo paths (must run in CI and in af worktrees).

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-11-18, do not re-derive):
- census/census-oo-deep.json (OO golden): keys engine,capturedAt,viewport,tabs,rightPanel,statusBar,backstage,menus,contextMenu,sectionErrors. tabs = DICT keyed by tab id: file, home, ins, draw, layout, links, review, protect, view, plugins, headerfooter, <one-uuid>, charttab — each value {label:str, contextual:bool, buttons:[{id,icon,label,enabled,x,y,w,h}]}. home has 42 buttons. Labels contain newlines ('Blank\\nPage') and shortcuts ('Bold (Ctrl+B)'). statusBar = list [{label,id,x,w}] (duplicates possible).
- census/census-react-deep.json (react census): keys engine,capturedAt,viewport,tabs,ribbon,fileMenu,pageErrors. ribbon = DICT keyed by react tab NAME ('Home','Insert','Layout','References','Collaboration','Protection','Draw','View','Forms'?,... — 14 keys at capture time; File is NOT a ribbon tab in react). Values = flat list [{label,disabled,kind}] — no groups. fileMenu = list [{label,enabled}] (react File backstage items).
- Tab resolution OO-key→react-name: OO tabs['file'] maps to react fileMenu; every other OO tab resolves via its .label ('home'.label=='Home'). OO 'ins'.label=='Insert'. Contextual tabs (headerfooter, charttab) resolve by label too ('Header & Footer','Chart Design' — match case-insensitively, react census may key 'Chart Design'/'Header & Footer').
- LABEL MATCHING: census/react-e2e/coverage-check.py already contains the battle-tested matcher: norm() (lowercase, strip parens/carets/Strg→Ctrl/space-fold), toks(), label_match(oo_label, react_labels_set) incl. token-subset rule (shared token >=4 chars, subset either direction, e.g. 'Text Highlight Color' ~ 'Highlight Color'). Add sys.path.insert(0, 'census/react-ee...') — path is census/react-e2e/ — and `from coverage_check import norm, label_match`? NO: the file is coverage-check.py (hyphen, not importable) — copy the three functions into build.py verbatim (they are ~30 lines) and keep a comment pointing at the source of truth.
- Empty OO label ('' — icon-only buttons): NO label-parity burden. Count them per tab as counts.iconOnly, do NOT emit control nodes for them.
- react-e2e/divergences.json: DICT {TabName: {normalized_label: reason}} — keys are coverage-check norm() forms, values are documentation strings. Special key '_tab' (value dict) = whole-tab divergence (e.g. 'AI' tab = product-specific, declared). A diverged tab's controls are still compared but its missing items count as 'diverged' (documented) not 'missing'. For control status: if tab has '_tab' entry OR norm(label) is a key in divergences[tab] → status 'diverged', carry the reason string.
- census/ledger.json: {features:[{feature,cluster,kind,oo,wo,level,evidence}]} — levels are ints 1..4 (L2=contracted, L3/L4=deep/L4-fidelity), clusters: chart,edit,file,formatting,headerfooter,image,insert,macros,other,page,plugins,protect (12).
- census/react-e2e/contract-results.json: {generated, results:[{id,name,ok}]} — probe ids: probe-health, probe-ribbon, probe-roundtrip, coverage-gate.

OUTPUT CONTRACT — census/port-graph/graph.json (PG-2/PG-3 depend on this EXACT shape):
{
 "generated": "<iso>",
 "sources": {"oo": "census/census/census-oo-deep.json", "react": "census/census/census-react-deep.json", "divergences": "census/react-e2e/divergences.json", "ledger": "census/ledger.json"},
 "surfaces": [
  {"id":"ribbon", "label":"Ribbon", "tabs":[{"id":"home","label":"Home","contextual":false,
    "counts":{"done":N,"diverged":N,"missing":N,"iconOnly":N,"total":N},
    "controls":[{"label":"Bold","ooLabel":"Bold (Ctrl+B)","status":"done|diverged|missing","reason":null|"str"}]}]},
  {"id":"filemenu", "label":"File Menu", "tabs":[{"id":"filemenu","label":"File","contextual":false,"counts":{...},"controls":[...]}]},
  {"id":"statusbar", "label":"Status Bar", "tabs":[{"id":"statusbar","label":"Status Bar",...,"controls":[...]}]},
  {"id":"ledger", "label":"Feature Ledger", "clusters":[{"id":"formatting","counts":{"features":N,"byLevel":{"1":N,"2":N,"3":N,"4":N}},"features":[{"id":"formatting.heading-1","level":4,"kind":"formatting"}]}]}
 ],
 "totals": {"controls":N,"done":N,"diverged":N,"missing":N,"iconOnly":N,"ledgerFeatures":N},
 "probes": ["probe-health",...]
}
Statuses are EXACTLY done|diverged|missing. Rollup counts must be consistent (done+diverged+missing+iconOnly==total per tab).
Statusbar: match OO statusBar labels against the SAME OO list (react statusbar census is not in these files — mark every OO statusbar item status 'done' only if... NO: you have no react statusbar artifact — emit status 'done' for items, with a per-surface caveat field "caveat": "react statusbar census not in artifacts; from ledger evidence" — VERIFIED: statusbar was closed via ledger/statusbar evidence; keep it simple and documented).

PORT-GRAPH.md: short spec — the 4 surfaces, node levels (Surface→Tab→Control; ledger: Surface→Cluster→Feature), status definitions incl. done-definition ('label present in react census OR documented divergence'), how to regenerate (python3 build.py), how to query (PG-2 report.py, PG-3 done-gate.py), and that the graph is a derived committed artifact (regenerate after census capture, never hand-edit).

build.py MUST print a one-line summary (totals) and exit 0. Run it once so graph.json is committed. Do NOT touch ingest.py/completeness.py (different task scope).

tasks.title: Drill-down report: coarse overview → --tab detail → --status filter
tasks.accept: /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/report.py | grep -qE 'ribbon|ledger' && /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/report.py --tab Home | grep -qiE 'bold|clipboard' && /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/report.py --tab Home --status missing | wc -l | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+' && /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/report.py --json | /usr/bin/python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert 'surfaces' in d and d['surfaces']; print('GATE OK')"
tasks.note:
Reads census/port-graph/graph.json (committed by PG-1 — READ ITS PORT-GRAPH.md for the exact shape; surfaces[].tabs[].controls[].status, ledger surface has clusters instead of tabs).

report.py (pure stdlib, /usr/bin/python3):
- default (coarse): one line per surface+tab: 'Home            done=37 diverged=0 missing=0 iconOnly=5  100%' + ledger cluster summary + grand totals + generated timestamp. ALIGNED columns.
- --tab <Name> (case-insensitive, matches tab label OR id, also 'filemenu'/'statusbar'): detail table — one row per control: status marker ([x] done / [~] diverged / [ ] missing), label (react label if matched, else ooLabel), reason text for diverged rows (wrap at 60 chars after label).
- --tab X --status missing|done|diverged: filter rows.
- --surface ribbon|ledger|filemenu|statusbar: restrict coarse view.
- --json: dump the parsed graph as-is (single JSON doc to stdout).
- Exit 0 on success; exit 2 with a clear message if graph.json missing or --tab not found.
- Include usage docstring; note in header: regenerate graph first via build.py.

tasks.title: Done-gate: undocumented-missing detector + rollup (CI-usable exit code)
tasks.accept: /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/done-gate.py | grep -q 'GATE OK' && /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/done-gate.py --surface ribbon | grep -qE 'ribbon' && /usr/bin/python3 census/port-graph/done-gate.py --strict; test $? -ne 127
tasks.note:
Reads census/port-graph/graph.json (committed by PG-1 — shape in census/port-graph/PORT-GRAPH.md).

done-gate.py (pure stdlib, /usr/bin/python3):
- Definition (print it in output header): a Tab/Surface is DONE when every OO control is status done or diverged (diverged = documented divergence with reason); 'missing' = OO control absent from react census WITHOUT documentation = debt.
- Output: per-surface rollup lines 'ribbon: 565 done, 3 diverged, 0 missing' + per-tab lines for any tab with missing>0 + grand totals + 'GATE OK' when total missing == 0.
- Exit 0 when missing==0; exit 1 when missing>0 (CI-ready).
- --strict: additionally fail (exit 1) if any diverged control lacks a reason string or any surface has a caveat about missing evidence (statusbar caveat from PG-1) — strict is the aspirational mode.
- --surface <id> restricts. Keep it under ~120 lines; no config files, no deps.
